comment: Source list for the US press desk (owner directive 2026-08-11). israeli_press_fetch.py reads this via --feeds; edit here, not in code. Every feed is fetched fail-open — a dead URL warns and is skipped, never blocks. Papers first, then the think tanks (the desk labels think-tank material as such, with the institution's lean stated). Some outlets 403 server-side fetches from some networks; they stay listed because they work from other runners, and a 403 only costs a warning line. WSJ and NYT full text sit behind paywalls — the desk works from what the feed and the open web carry, and attributes precisely.
noFeedComment: Sources the desk still sweeps every morning, by WebFetch of the index page rather than RSS. Checked 2026-08-11: neither serves a usable feed to a server-side client, so they sit here instead of in feeds[] and the wire stops printing a dead-feed warning every run. Re-test occasionally and move an outlet back up when its feed returns.

noFeed.note: Every documented RSS path 404s and the homepage advertises none.
All /feed/ paths return an HTML interstitial to non-browser clients, not XML.
